description: Multi-agent orchestration interface with agent cards, tool-call timeline, and run management.

integrations: Server-Sent Events for live step streaming
architectureNotes: OrchestratorPage provides a two-column layout: agent cards on left, run timeline in center.
AgentRunView renders a vertical timeline of steps with collapsible tool call details.
AgentCard displays individual agent identity, status, tools, and activity.
Wire /api/agents/run to your agent framework — stream steps as SSE events.
Each step should include: agentId, action, toolCall (optional), output, duration, status.
